name: Shadowclaws
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, magus 2 sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw See text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You grow wicked claws made from dark wisps of shadow by drawing in nearby light. When you cast this spell you gain two primary claw attacks as natural weapons which each deal 1d6 damage plus one cold damage per caster level. Enemies struck by both claws in a single round must make a Fortitude save or become fatigued for one round. If you are grappling a creature while you have these claws they must make a save each round they remain grappled to avoid becoming fatigued. This spell cannot cause a creature to become exhausted.
